headline: The photos they'll go looking for one day are the ones with you in them
items: The blurry 3am one, you in the chair, them wide awake
You in yesterday's shirt, holding them up to the light
The mirror selfie where your arm is cut off and their face is perfect
The one taken when you didn't know, mid-laugh
turn: You'll think you look tired. They'll think you look like home.
